column1: # answers, one case per line, read by ALL THREE twins so they cannot drift apart:
# The data row count is declared on the next line; every reader asserts it, so
# a reader that drops a row (a last row with no trailing newline) goes red.
# Columns (TAB-separated; no empty cell, a TAB would collapse):
#   new_name  name passed as NEW        (<empty> = the empty string)
#   new_val   value of NEW in the env   (- = unset, <empty> = set to "")
#   old_val   value of OLD in the env
#   want_rc   0 = true, 1 = false, 2 = invalid name (the call fails closed)
# A name is "set" when non-empty. It is "truthy" when set and not 0, false, no
# or off (any case). restrict is true when either name is truthy. permit is true
# only when at least one name is truthy and no set name is falsy.
# restrict: the marker that switches a guard ON; a per-call NEW=0 must not lift OLD=1
# permit: a widening switch (*_OK, lift, AFK); any set falsy name vetoes it
# invalid names fail closed with 2, whatever the values are
